title.narrative: World Bank/IBRD - Danish purchase of hybrid capital 2024/2025

description.narrative:
In support of the World Bank's reform process ("Evolution") initiated in 2022, Denmark was among the first 11 countries to announce a planned Danish purchase of hybrid capital of DKK 400 mill during the World Bank's spring meetings 2024.
Hybrid capital is a new innovative financing instrument that will strengthen the World Bank's ability to help countries deal with cross-border challenges such as climate, conflict and pandemics. As a result of the Bank's financing model, hybrid capital will be leveraged up to 1:8, and a Danish contribution of DKK 400 mill. DKK will thus be converted into up to DKK 3.2 bill. DKK
The purchase of hybrid capital can be converted into equity, including voting shares, and can therefore be seen as an advance payment of the Danish contribution in terms of a later capital increase of the World Bank (IBRD specifically).
